title: 2021 Copyright
description: If you find yourself in Ireland with a 2021 copyright, you'll likely be in the very north of the country.

title: 2021 coverage in the north
description: In Ireland, apart from a few reprocessed panoramas, 2021 coverage is always in the northern third of the island, including Northern Ireland. The Google car has since revisited this area in 2024 and 2025.

title: Mini pylon
description: Ireland occasionally has these mini pylons, much smaller than standard lattice pylons. They are unique to Ireland, which makes them useful for an Ireland/UK 50/50.

title: Delta pylon in Ireland
description: Ireland has some fairly generic Delta pylons, mostly in the midlands, the east and the south. There are few to no Delta pylons in the UK, so in an Ireland/UK 50/50 a Delta pylon almost always means Ireland.
